install_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export USER="${USER:-root}"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"

echo "==> Installing Cursor CLI (agent)"

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y ca-certificates curl bash
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf install -y ca-certificates curl bash
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apk add --no-cache ca-certificates curl bash
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pacman -Sy --noconfirm ca-certificates curl bash
fi

curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash

# Ensure ~/.local/bin is on PATH for login and interactive shells.
PROFILE_SNIPPET='
# Cursor CLI (cursor-cli)
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
'
for profile in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.profile" /etc/profile.d/cursor-cli.sh; do
  dir="$(dirname "$profile")"
  mkdir -p "$dir"
  if [ ! -f "$profile" ] || ! grep -q 'Cursor CLI (cursor-cli)' "$profile" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '%s\n' "$PROFILE_SNIPPET" >> "$profile"
  fi
done

if ! command -v agent >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/agent" ]; then
    ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/agent" /usr/local/bin/agent
  elif [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/cursor-agent" ]; then
    ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/cursor-agent" /usr/local/bin/agent
  fi
fi

echo "==> Verifying installation"
agent --version
echo "==> Cursor CLI installed at $(command -v agent)"
uninstall_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"

echo "==> Removing Cursor CLI (agent)"
rm -f "$HOME/.local/bin/agent" "$HOME/.local/bin/cursor-agent" /usr/local/bin/agent /usr/local/bin/cursor-agent
rm -rf "$HOME/.local/share/cursor-agent"
for f in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.profile" /etc/profile.d/cursor-cli.sh; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  if [ "$f" = /etc/profile.d/cursor-cli.sh ]; then
    rm -f "$f"
    continue
  fi
  tmp="$(mktemp)"
  awk '
    /Cursor CLI \(cursor-cli\)/ { skip=1; next }
    skip && /^export PATH=.*\.local\/bin/ { skip=0; next }
    { skip=0; print }
  ' "$f" > "$tmp" || true
  mv "$tmp" "$f"
done
echo "==> Cursor CLI removed (auth/config left intact if present)"
upgrade_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"

echo "==> Upgrading Cursor CLI (agent)"
if command -v agent >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  agent update || curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash
else
  curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash
fi
agent --version
echo "==> Upgrade complete"
